ai_summary: Can Fin Homes Limited reported robust H1 FY27 growth in loan book, Net Interest Income, and Profit After Tax, coupled with improved asset quality through lower NPA ratios. However, Q2 FY27 disbursements saw a year-over-year decline, materially impacted by operational disruptions during the rollout of "PROJECT TEJAS," a significant IT transformation initiative, which explicitly reduced disbursals in affected branches. This operational challenge, alongside a slight compression in Q2 profitability metrics like Net Interest Margin and Return on Equity, presents a key area for monitoring despite the strategic focus on digital acceleration.
